information_gain_requirement: A visual system that prevents readiness and later outcome stages from collapsing into one score.
structural_pattern: one spine -> eight independent proof cards -> boundary footer
cta: Log the stage you can actually prove.
risk_boundary: No arrow may imply that one outcome stage automatically causes or proves the next.

measurement_hypothesis.prediction: The visual may improve correct stage labeling in the next internal review.
measurement_hypothesis.falsifier: The next internal review still collapses two or more outcome stages after 7 days.
